entries.title: Web Search
entries.description: Enhanced web search with multiple provider support (Bing, Brave, SearXNG, etc.)
entries.detail: Adds powerful web search capabilities to your AI assistant. Supports multiple search providers with fallback.

entries.title: Code Runner
entries.description: Run JavaScript, Python, and Shell code directly in chat
entries.detail: Execute code snippets in multiple languages. Supports sandboxed execution with workspace integration.

entries.title: Sticker Pack
entries.description: 116 built-in stickers for meme battles and fun conversations
entries.detail: A collection of 116 stickers organized by category. Includes reaction memes, emotions, and fun expressions.

entries.title: Document Reader
entries.description: Read and analyze PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and EPUB files
entries.detail: Parse documents and extract text content for AI analysis. Supports multiple document formats.

entries.title: Image Generation
entries.description: Generate images using AI models (DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, etc.)
entries.detail: Create images from text prompts. Supports multiple image generation backends.

entries.title: Voice Chat
entries.description: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech for hands-free conversations
entries.detail: Enable voice interaction with your AI assistant. Supports multiple ASR and TTS providers.
